summary: Suzi discusses pulling strategy for the upcoming Child of Chaos limited banner, recommending most players save at least 300 summons to secure a copy. She explains her own decision to pull on the Selected Summons III banner to get the new Burn legendary hero Vyressa and a duplicate Paixton to reach his Inspiration 2 upgrade. After exceptionally lucky pulls—including two copies of Vyressa within 300 summons—she claims Paixton from the 300-summon selector, unlocks his team-wide Defense Penetration buff, and fully builds Vyressa's skills and talents.

heroes.name: Vyressa
heroes.note: Replaces Karf in Burn teams with 5-hit full-board damage, making her an ideal wielder for Witch's Remains or Mystic Conch.

heroes.name: Paixton
heroes.verdict: High-priority Inspiration 2 hero for Burn teams
heroes.note: Inspiration 2 grants allies 25% Attack Up and 25% Defense Penetration via Molten Armor, significantly boosting overall team DPS.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Upcoming limited hero banner with a 300-summon pity guarantee; players should save resources to guarantee at least one copy.

meta_changes: Vyressa releases as a direct upgrade over Karf for multi-hit full-board Burn application and debuffing.
tips: Save at least 300 summons for limited banners like Child of Chaos to guarantee getting the featured hero.
Aim for Paixton's Inspiration 2 if running a endgame Burn team to grant 25% Defense Penetration to all allies.
Build Vyressa with high Accuracy and artifact options like Witch's Remains or Puppeteer set to capitalize on her 5-hit AoE ultimate.
title: I KNEW IT! It was meant to be! 💥 I Summoned for BURN Already... 🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
